examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhu, antopūtibhāvo? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
katamā ca, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā pūtimacche vā jāyanti pūtikuṇape vā pūtikummāse vā candanikāye vā oḷigalle vā jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, saṃsedajā yoni.
tassa pūti-kāyakamm'antassa pūti-vacīkamm'antassa pūti-manokamm'antassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālaṅ'kiriyā.

47206.commentary: (MNa) pūtimuttan'ti muttam'eva. yathā hi manussabhāvo suvaṇṇavaṇṇo pūtikāyotv'eva, tadahujātā'pi galocilatā pūtilatātv'eva vuccati. evaṃ taṅ'khaṇaṃ gahitaṃ taruṇam'pi muttaṃ pūtimuttam'eva. (ANa) pūtimuttan'ti yaṃkiñci muttaṃ. yathā hi suvaṇṇavaṇṇo'pi kāyo pūtikāyo'ti vuccati, evaṃ abhinavam'pi muttaṃ pūtimuttam'eva.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ te pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya paṇḍukarogī.

47207.meaning1: medicine made from fermented cow urine

examples.text: evam'evaṃ te pūtimuttabhesajjaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa

47208.commentary: (MNa) pūtimūlānī'ti maṃse vā lohite vā sati tiṭṭhanti. tassa pana abhāve cammakhaṇḍe lomāni viya hatthe'y'eva lagganti, taṃ sandhāy'āha, pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā patantī'ti.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, imam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

47209.commentary: (SNPa) pūtilatan'ti gaḷocīlataṃ. yathā hi suvaṇṇavaṇṇo'pi kāyo pūtikāyo, vassasatiko'pi sunakho kukkuro, tadahujāto'pi siṅgālo jarasiṅgālo'ti vuccati, evaṃ abhinavā'pi gaḷocīlatā asārakattena pūtilatā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: usabho'r'iva chetva bandhanāni, nāgo pūtilataṃ'va dālayitvā, n'āhaṃ pun'upessaṃ gabbhaseyyaṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

47210.meaning1: rotting mass; fetid body; putrid accumulation

examples.text: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.
tassa pūti-kāyakamm'antassa pūti-vacīkamm'antassa pūti-manokamm'antassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālaṅ'kiriyā.
atha kho kāṇāya sāmiko kāṇāya santike dūtaṃ pāhesi, āgacchatu kāṇā, icchāmi kāṇāya āgatan'ti. atha kho kāṇamātā upāsikā kismiṃ viya rittahatthaṃ gantun'ti pūpaṃ paci.
tasmiṃ aruṇavatiyā nagare, pūpiko pūpavikkayena jīvikaṃ kappento ahosin'ti attho.
yadūnakaṃ taṃ saṇati, yaṃ pūraṃ santam'eva taṃ, aḍḍhakumbh'ūpamo bālo, rahado pūro'va paṇḍito.
vāsito'va surabhī karaṇḍako, pupphapūra mama uttam'aṅgajo, taṃ jarāy'atha salomagandhikaṃ, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

47216.meaning1: who fulfils; who completes; who satisfies
47216.meaning2: who fills, fulfils or completes, full, full of

examples.text: vadhadaṇḍatajjitā'ti daṇḍakaṃ gahetvā vadhena tajjitā, ghātessāmi nan'ti vuttā. dāsīsaman'ti sāmikassa vattapūrikā dāsī'ti maṃ bhagavā dhāretū'ti vatvā saraṇesu patiṭṭhāsi.

47217.meaning1: name of an ascetic teacher; Pūraṇa Kassapa

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho asamo devaputto pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.
jānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ rukkhaṃ ārohituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyyan'ti.
m'āvamaññetha pāpassa, na man'taṃ āgamissati, udabindunipātena, udakumbho'pi pūrati, bālo pūrati pāpassa, thokaṃ thokam'pi ācinaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati

47228.meaning2: having made fill; having caused to be full

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ mahante mahante sāṇipasibbake kārāpetvā hiraññasuvaṇṇassa pūrāpetvā sakaṭehi nibbāhāpetvā majjhe gaṅgāya sote osādehi.

47229.meaning1: filled up; filled (something) to the brim (with)

examples.text: so tasmiṃ dvinnaṃ gehānaṃ antare ubhato dīghaṃ āvāṭaṃ khaṇāpetvā gūthakalalassa pūrāpesi
idāni so, bhante, udapāno thūṇeyyakehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūrito, mā te muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ apaṃsū'ti.

47231.synonym: ciṇṇa, paripuṇṇa, paripūrita, pariyosita, vusita, vūsita

47233.meaning1: who has fulfilled the quality of being cordial

47235.meaning1: should be filled out; should be expanded

examples.text: (dutiyavagge viya catuvīsati suttāni pūretabbāni.)
puṇṇe pūrassu dhammehi, cando pannarase'r'iva, paripuṇṇāya paññāya, tamokhandhaṃ padālayā'ti.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyyan'ti. so taṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyya ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyya.

so taṃ disvā, bhante, imasmiṃ sāsane kati dhurāni nāmā'ti pucchi. āvuso, vipassanādhuraṃ, ganthadhuran'ti. bhante, gantho nāma paṭibalassa bhāro, mayhaṃ pana dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, vipassanādhuraṃ pūressāmi kammaṭṭhānaṃ me dethā'ti vanditvā nisīdi.
evaṃ sante mayaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇacaṇḍālam'pi na pūrema.

47240.meaning1: to fulfil; to complete; to accomplish
47240.meaning2: to fill, to fulfil, to complete

examples.text: atha naṃ, idaṃ sītalaṃ bhavissatī'ti kaṭacchuṃ pūretvā ādāya āgacchantiṃ uttarāya dāsiyo disvā, apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti.
rājā te sabbe gāhāpetvā rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇe āvāṭe khaṇāpetvā te tattha nisīdāpetvā paṃsūhi pūretvā upari palāle vikirāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

47242.meaning1: having fulfilled; having completed; having accomplished

examples.text: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti
atha kho te thūṇeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā udapānaṃ tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūresuṃ, mā te muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ apaṃsū'ti.

47245.meaning1: cake; (comm) various sweets and pastries made as a gift

examples.text: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.

47247.commentary: (VINt) evaṃ pūve odane ca bhājane pakkhipitvā tajjaṃ udakaṃ datvā madditvā katā pūvasurā odanasurā'ti ca vuccati.

examples.text: surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.

47248.commentary: (DNt) pūvikā'ti pūvasampādakā, ye pūvam'eva nānappakārato sampādetvā vikkiṇantā jīvan'ti.

examples.text: gaṇikā kumbhadāsī ca, pūvikā macchikā'pi ca, yathāsakena thāmena, pūgadhammaṃ akaṃsu te.
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.
upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, lok'āmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho'ti.

naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ

apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati
okkhittacakkhunā antaraghare gantabbaṃ yugamattaṃ pekkhantena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca tahaṃ tahaṃ olokento antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
yo ve buddhena codito, bhikkhu saṅghassa pekkhato, migāramātupāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi.
ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.
tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.

47262.grammar: abs of caus of pa √ikkh, caus, trans (+acc)
47262.meaning1: having showed around; having given a tour

47265.commentary: (DNa) na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā'ti viceyya pekkhitā nāma yo kujjhitvā yadā naṃ paro oloketi, tadā nimmīleti na oloketi, puna gacchantaṃ kujjhitvā oloketi, evarūpo n'āhosi. vineyyapekkhitā'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno na ca visaṭaṃ, na ca visāci, na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā, ujuṃ tathā pasaṭam'ujumano, piyacakkhunā bahujanaṃ udikkhitā ahosi.

47266.meaning1: to see; to take a look (at)

examples.text: atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā rohaṇo ca pekhuṇiyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.

yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, tam'pi n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti samanupassati.
ye me petā ñātī sālohitā kālaṅ'katā pasannacittā anussaranti tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ assa mah'ānisaṃsan'ti
supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.
saṅghassa añjaliṃ katvā, idh'ekacce vadām'ahaṃ, apaviddhā anāthā te, yathā petā tath'eva te.
yathā vārivahā pūrā paripūrenti sāgaraṃ, evam'eva ito dinnaṃ petānaṃ upakappati.

47277.commentary: (VINa) petapariggahe'ti ettha pana pettivisaye upapannā'pi kālaṃ katvā tasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve nibbattā'pi cātumahārājik'ādayo devā'pi sabbe petā'tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gatā, tesaṃ pariggahe anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

47279.meaning1: world of the departed; ghost realm

examples.text: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.
saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.

47281.meaning1: lying posture of a dead person; (comm) lying posture of a ghost
47281.commentary: (DNa) yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, petā uttānā sentī'ti ayaṃ petaseyyā. appamaṃsalohitattā hi petā aṭṭhisaṅghāṭajaṭitā ekena passena sayituṃ na sakkonti, uttānā'va senti.

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, petaseyyā? yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, petā uttānā senti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, petaseyyā.

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.

47285.construction:
pa + e + ta + ī
peta + ī

examples.text: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

47288.commentary: (JAa) mātāpettibharā'ti jiṇṇe andhe mātāpitaro posenti, etādisā nesaṃ dhammikatā. (JAa) mātāpettibharo'ti analaso hutvā rattin'divaṃ mātāpitaro bhari.

examples.text: kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.
yena saccen'ayaṃ sāmo, mātāpettibharo ahu, etena saccavajjena, visaṃ sāmassa haññatu.

47289.meaning1: paternal; coming from one's father; belonging to the father
47289.commentary: (MNa) aññaṃ pettikaṃ aññaṃ pitāmahan'ti yaṃ pana te pitu ca pitāmahānañ'ca santakaṃ, taṃ aññaṃ'y'eva, nihitañ'ca payuttañ'ca ativiya bahu. ettha ca pitāmahan'ti taddhitalopaṃ katvā vuttan'ti veditabbaṃ. petāmahan'ti vā pāṭho.

examples.text: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātā-pettika-sambhavo odanakummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

47297.meaning1: leading to the ghost realm; conducive to the world of the forefathers

examples.text: pettivisayaṃ c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, pajānāmi, pettivisayagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ, pettivisayagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pettivisayaṃ upapajjati tañ'ca pajānāmi.

47298.meaning1: to be experienced in the ghost realm

47299.meaning1: honouring one's father; respecting one's own father

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye petteyyā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye apetteyyā
matteyyā hotha petteyyā, kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyikā, sāmaññā hotha brahmaññā, evaṃ saggaṃ gamissathā'ti.
